summary: Connected-head priority survives this disruption as a useful analytical recommendation. Three structural counterexamples survive against treating the frozen roadmap as a dispatch-ready next-task guide: future evidence is a preauthorization prerequisite, resource control is off the head dependency path, and mandatory eight-view evidence is off that path. Split preflight/postflight states and make cap/evidence gates explicit before dispatch. No new modeling or owner acceptance follows.

counterexamples.claim: The listed prerequisites can be completed before authorizing the first connected-head successor.
counterexamples.scenario: A strict continuation worker waits for MB-T015 to close before MB-T001. MB-T015 requires a checkpoint09→Loop01→Loop02→Loop03→successor sheet, although MB-T001 is the task that authorizes and produces that successor. The numeric DAG is acyclic while the evidence workflow is circular. MB-T013 also combines baseline freezing with an exact future candidate revision.
counterexamples.smallest_falsification_test: Show a separately labeled baseline preservation/reference freeze that closes preflight without future successor bytes, then show postflight comparisons remain mandatory after modeling.
counterexamples.test_performed: Read MB-T001 prerequisites and MB-T013/015 closure evidence. Computed MB-T001 ancestors as MB-T013 and MB-T015. MB-T015 explicitly includes a successor sheet. No separate preflight completion field exists.
counterexamples.result: SURVIVES: ambiguity can block honest dispatch or encourage closing preservation without its promised successor evidence.
counterexamples.smallest_correction: Split MB-T013/015 into baseline preflight and successor postflight states; MB-T001 requires only the exact completed baseline state. Keep successor hashes/comparison a postflight gate.

counterexamples.claim: Following the head dependency graph necessarily establishes operational resource caps before dispatch.
counterexamples.scenario: A worker follows the complete MB-T001–006 prerequisite closure and begins head construction while MB-T062 remains unfinished. Proposed shared ceilings and stop prose exist, but named accounting/interrupt accountability and the harmless cap drill are not prerequisite gates.
counterexamples.smallest_falsification_test: Compute the selected head prerequisite closure and verify MB-T062 or an equivalent series-wide completed dispatch gate appears; before actual modeling, replay the selected cap/stop ledger with a harmless breach.
counterexamples.test_performed: Calculated all MB-T001–006 ancestor sets. None includes MB-T062; no series_dispatch_prerequisite field exists. MB-T062 itself depends on the same baseline tasks.
counterexamples.result: SURVIVES: supports OUT04 rather than challenging the connected-head choice. The counterexample is lack of enforced sequencing, not proof a budget will be exceeded.
counterexamples.smallest_correction: Make completed MB-T062 or an explicit equivalent dispatch ledger a series-wide gate; include selected task scope, shared accounting unit, named stopper and interrupt action. Do not claim hard enforcement until the harmless controller drill is observed.

counterexamples.claim: Closing the recommended connected-head packet necessarily supplies every implementation-checkpoint view required by current goal.
counterexamples.scenario: Root selects MB-T001–006 under the 45-minute/12000-token head envelope. MB-T001 requests a whole-bird comparison and MB-T006 requests both profiles/three-quarter views. Their prerequisite closure omits MB-T014, which specifies the required eight-angle, all-era, both-light packet. A narrow head closure could therefore omit mandatory checkpoint evidence.
counterexamples.smallest_falsification_test: Freeze the selected head packet closure including MB-T014 or an explicit equivalent mandatory evidence gate; map each goal-required angle/era/light to an output before dispatch.
counterexamples.test_performed: Computed MB-T006 closure: MB-T001–005, MB-T013 and MB-T015, with neither MB-T014 nor equivalent eight-view completion field. Read current goal line75, which requires eight-angle views, same-camera comparisons and exhibit hero views at every implementation checkpoint.
counterexamples.result: SURVIVES as dispatch ambiguity. Goal guidance still governs; the roadmap does not revoke it. Rendering cost also needs room inside the shared ceiling.
counterexamples.smallest_correction: Bind the selected head packet final gate to mandatory matched eight-view/close-up evidence. Include rendering/export/QC in the shared envelope; if evidence cannot fit, stop and report a partial checkpoint without closure.
